# stdout-logs

This mod allows any specified log files to be tailed and included in the container's STDOUT.

Add it to any LinuxServer.io container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-stdout-logs
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-stdout-logs|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

Simply set the environment variable `LOGS_TO_STDOUT` with a pipe-delimited (`|`) list of log files to include, such as `LOGS_TO_STDOUT="/config/logs/radarr.txt|/config/logs/radarr.debug.txt"`.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/universal-stdout-logs/
